title: Method for organotypic tissue culture in the aged animal
author: Schommer, Schrag, et al.

steps.title: Prepare Day 0 media
steps.instruction: Make two batches of Day 0 media in sterile 50 mL centrifuge tubes; optionally prepare 2–3 batches if extra volume or future colour change is anticipated.

substeps.instruction: Hibernate A (preparation medium): add 250 µL of 0.5 mM Glutamine stock, 10 mL Horse Serum, and 40 mL standard Hibernate A medium.
Neurobasal A (growth medium): add 8 mL (20 %) Horse Serum, 400 µL standard antibiotic/antimycotic mixture, and 40 mL Neurobasal A medium.

steps.title: Prepare treatment media (Day 1/4)
steps.instruction: On the day of use, prepare fresh treatment media for Day 1 and Day 4 in sterile 50 mL tubes.

substeps.instruction: Neurobasal A (growth medium 1): add 8 mL (20 %) Horse Serum, 800 µL (2 %) B27 supplement, 400 µL standard antibiotic/antimycotic mixture, and 40 mL Neurobasal A medium.
Neurobasal A (growth medium 2): add 8 mL (20 %) Horse Serum, 800 µL (2 %) B27 supplement, 400 µL standard antibiotic/antimycotic mixture, and 40 mL Neurobasal A medium.

steps.title: Set up McIlwain chopper
steps.instruction: Adjust the McIlwain chopper for the desired slice thickness (250 µm or 300 µm) and ready the stage for slicing.

substeps.instruction: Install a sharp double‑sided razor and loosely attach the clamp.
Clean the stage and blade thoroughly with 70 % ethanol.
Place a sterile Teflon insert surrounded by two filter‑paper disks on the stage.
Turn the dial so the arm drops onto the stage; ensure the blade rests flush and tighten the clamp.
Just before use, wet the top filter paper with a few drops of Hibernate A medium and wet the blade with a paintbrush.

steps.title: Prepare culture inserts
steps.instruction: Aliquot growth medium into dishes, place Millicell inserts, and pre‑incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.1 mL of growth medium 1 to each 35 mm tissue‑culture dish.
Place one Millicell insert in each dish, avoiding air bubbles beneath the membrane.
Store the dishes in a 35 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator for at least 1 hour before use.
Expect to use ~3 dishes per mouse (8–10 slices/dish) or 12–15 dishes per rabbit (4–6 slices/dish).

steps.title: Anesthetize animal and dissect tissue
steps.instruction: Euthanize the animal, isolate the region of interest, and keep it cold.

substeps.instruction: Anesthetize with Euthasol diluted 1:1 with dH₂O (alternatives: CO₂ or Ketamine/Xylazine) and rapidly decapitate.
Dissect the desired brain area and place it in chilled preparation medium in a 100 mm tissue‑culture dish.
Keep the dish on ice for no more than 5 minutes.

steps.title: Slice tissue and collect slices
steps.instruction: Cut the tissue on the chopper and allow slices to rest briefly.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the tissue to the chopper stage and slice at the preset thickness.
Move the sliced tissue to a new 100 mm dish containing chilled preparation medium; let sit for 5 minutes.
Transfer slices to another 100 mm dish containing 4 mL chilled preparation medium (reduced volume facilitates handling).

steps.title: Transfer slices onto inserts
steps.instruction: Separate individual slices and place them onto the pre‑incubated Millicell membranes.

substeps.instruction: Using a small size‑2 oil paintbrush and a scalpel, gently tease slices apart.
Pull each slice from its outer edge onto the scalpel blade with the brush, taking care not to damage the tissue.
Place the slice from the blade onto the membrane of a pre‑incubated dish using the brush on the outer extremity.
Each membrane can hold 8–10 mouse hippocampal slices or 4–6 rabbit slices.

steps.title: Change medium during culture
steps.instruction: Perform scheduled medium exchanges to maintain slice health.

substeps.instruction: Replace the medium on Day 1 and then every third day; change as quickly as possible, handling only 2–4 dishes at a time if needed.
Replace half of the growth medium every 3–4 days once slices are attached (full attachment occurs by day 10).
For low‑density plates (3–5 sections per membrane), exchange medium every 7–10 days.

steps.title: Optional antibiotic removal after Day 4
steps.instruction: If desired, omit the standard antibiotic/antimycotic mixture after Day 4 without increasing infection risk.
